facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Guan Di Temple on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is one of Phu Quoc's oldest Chinese temples, and most visitors never find it. Incense smoke, red lanterns, locals praying. Zero tour groups. This is the side of the island the beach bars don't show you. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Red lanterns. Incense curling upward. Not a tourist in sight. Guan Di Temple is right off Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and almost nobody stops. Worth every minute.

instagram.caption: Locals don't post about Guan Di Temple. Red lanterns, incense, zero crowds. This is the real Phu Quoc. Save it.
instagram.video_caption: Walked past once. Went back. Guan Di Temple hits different when it's just you and the incense smoke.
